mods.title: NOW OR NEVER + 0NLY HOP3
mods.description: So I've found a forgotten Sonic 2 Genesis Cartridge which was left abandoned in years, I wanted to see what went wrong. I put the cartridge in my Genesis console and the first instances I saw is Sonic having no eyes in the title, which is weird. But didn't mind through and started the game, the game itself started off as normal and then completed Emerald Hill Zone Act 1. As soon as I continuing the game, Sonic suddenly stopped. I tried to get him to move but Tails is still moving based on my controls strangely enough. However, what this game did is went through the Debug mode and placed a bunch of waterfalls and moving fast randomly by itself when Debug mode wasn't supposed to unlock (which is only when I have to unlock in Sound Test). And when done, I've seen the changes, the palletes have changed such as the monkey itself, but most importantly... That Sonic changed his pallete and even the eyes were removed by itself I saw from earlier. Who is it? ...Ashura? What kind of name is thi--...Wait, what is my Sonic doing? He's getting closer torwards Tails and I can't control Tails anymore. What is this? Did someone just modified this cartridge to think that it's a completely normal copy of Sonic 2? Sonic wants help from me? But how? I don't have his control anymore... Could it be--S0N1C (and Parallax) is created (and hosted) by RightBurstUltra (and Cosmos).While "4SHUR4W4RE" (shown here in the mod) is created by RikuRiku123 as their take of S0N1C, not wanted with the association with RightBurstUltra.This song started out as just a 0ne L1fe retake concept, but the composer got so motivated that she decided to finish it in a matter of weeks.(And no, this is not Aethos. Don't even say that, this is not left eyed covered stuff.)However, in this mod, this Sonic is being used as Ashura, the most famous Sonic 2 Debug glitch. So while I (Herox) couldn't do sprites or do poses for S0n1c first phase, this stands out. Although, we got this one of what could've been on their "Rightbust Pack" mod named "0NLY HOP3" OST by the same composer "Starlite Music" (shown after few gameplay images).The story for it is unknown, but I'd like to think that Sonic is stuck in their possessed body which got possessed by Ashura. The player's control is unable to do anything while Ashura is able to move freely. And while we're there, Ashura wants to do something to Tails which makes Tails worried (while it's my own story, their story is different since they made some things up for S0N1C).So here's YugamiShi's bit of lore about Ashura here:"4SHUR4W4RE, or just W4RE is Sonic after being corrupted by a malware that made him become Ashura, at first, Sonic tried to fight to maintain control of his body, but he lost, and now the malware has total control not only of Sonic, but of the entire game, except for one character, Tails, but in the end, not even Tails was able to escape the corruption made by the malware, but it depends on the player, which means that Tails will always be in an infinite torture of always being corrupted in the end."For S0N1C is unknown as we don't know any lore about him as far as I (Herox) know (or maybe I missed it).

At that moment, no one was safe, And then, everything went dark, and nothing remained but the rotting carcasses of innocent corpses. You must have shit in your mind, I'm going to rip your dick off and make you swallow it back!"  The voice doesn't respond back, "HMPH! Asshole..." BF whispers as he walks towards what looks like a bright light, and as he approaches he encounters his first opponent. mods.title: [0.8.8] V SLICE MULTIPLAYER ONLINE[Beta]PC/Android
mods.description: Update:Global Slice 1.2 Beta Preview10 is an experimental multiplayer online fork/mod of FNF V-SliceIt adds online match rooms, Arena Mode, spectator mode, Global Active Rooms, global chat, avatars/skins, and PC/Android supportOh I just came across this video, a totally normal multiplayer gameplay, you can take it as a showcase, watching it says more than a thousand words lolThis is still a beta. Some UI elements, offsets, Android behavior and online features may still changeHow to play online with a friend:1. Open The Multiplayer menu - PC: Press b in the main menu - Android / mouse : press multiplayer panel2. One player creates a room -Give it a recognizable name so your friend can find it3. The other player joins the room from the list4. Pick a song, difficulty and variation5. Both players press Ready to Start Spectator Mode:You can spectate a match and its progress; you are just a spectator, To play, you have to join through join. While playing, you might see an eye with a counter showing the spectatorsArena Mode:Arena Mode is enabled by default and is the recommended way to play onlineIt loads matches in a safer online environment Loading the original song directly can be unstable with some heavy or heavily modified mods, especially on AndroidOnly turn off Arena Mode if you know what you are doingMods:To play online with mods, both players need the same song/chart availableIf one player is missing the required mod or chart, the match may fail or the song may not load correctly, This preview keeps some legacy compatibility features from Global Slice 1.1 to help players use compatible mods for online matches (I’ll talk more about this in detail soon, but it’s playable with mods right now)But what if I want to play with a friend using a manual mod? : The game will look in your mods folder to see if the same song and variant exist as your opponent. To play manually placed mods, you should turn off the 'verify both charts' button since that one checks that both of you have exactly the same thing; otherwise, it might cause problems.Global Active Rooms:Global Active Rooms are not 1v1 matchesThey are always-open song rooms where you may see other players in near real-time if they are playing the same song/variation, For real 1v1 gameplay, use Match Rooms and Arena ModeJust to clarify, it's still a beta and any suggestions are welcome

mods.title: VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY
mods.description: VS IMPOSTOR IS BACK!A from-the-ground-up remaster of the 2023 mod, VS IMPOSTOR V4! VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY intends to be faithful to the original experience, while introducing new tweaks and features to make it the definitive version of the mod you know and love!VS IMPOSTOR is a total-conversion mod for Friday Night Funkin', in which you face off against colorful Among Us characters. With over 10 weeks and 57 songs! this mod has plenty of content for you to explore, especially with brand-new awards and cosmetics for you to find and collect! And who knows? maybe there are more secrets to discover...OPTIMIZATIONTHE MOD IS ACTUALLY OPTIMIZED NOW... here's a little comparison of Danger alone... although in the real v4 nothing ever unloaded from your memory so by the time you'd get to danger on a fresh playthrough it'd probably be more like 4gigsLANGUAGEThis time around, the mod's not only in English! We've brought members of the community together and have translated the mod into 28 languages!EXPANDED COSMICUBE!Legacy's Cosmicube has been heavily expanded compared to the original from 2023. With tons of new skins and pets to find, you'll have a lot more to find and discover!AWARDSThere are 28 new awards for you to unlock! Will you get them all?BRAND-NEW DLC!With 5 new songs, and an entirely new Cosmicube, the SECURITY DLC will be made available when Legacy launches on April 25th!To install, just drag and drop the "securitydlc" folder into the content folderStill need help? Follow our video guide!MODDINGWanna make your own cosmicube? Add your own week or songs! Check out the official modding doc!
mods.author: Clowfoe

mods.title: V.S. Whitty Full Week (LEGACY)
mods.description: While strolling with your Girlfriend though an alleyway, you happen to notice an ominous glow coming from around the corner. Out steps Whitmore (Whitty), a hot-headed rock star who happens to have some beef with your Girlfriends parents. Think you've got what it takes to get him outta there?Base game changes:VS Whitty adds a new input system, which is based off other rhythm games like etterna/quaver.VS Whitty also changes the default WASD keybinds to DFJK.Please go and support the artist and composer of the music here: https://www.instagram.com/sock.clip/Support Kade, who coded all the hard stuff here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fzy2mi1CxKwListen to the soundtrack here: https://soundcloud.com/sock-wav/sets/back-alley-blitz-vs-whitty-fnf-mod-pack
mods.author: Nate Anim8

mods.title: Friday Night Funkin': Doki Doki Takeover Plus!
mods.description: After a year's worth of work, the final update to Friday Night Funkin' Doki Doki Takeover is here! Presenting, Doki Doki Takeover Plus!The FNF and DDLC worlds have entangled, causing unusual things to occur when Monika finds herself in the Hating Sim and when Boyfriend and Girlfriend wind up in the Literature Club. How shall things fare for these three and the rest of the club?This mod includes:>30+ Songs featuring all your favorite Literature Club members!>A full fledged story spanning across several weeks!>40+ Costumes for each character!>Lots of secret content to discover!
mods.author: DusterBuster
